entities.name: Kaalia
entities.description: A powerful double-winged human cleric from Alara who can beckon angels, dragons and demons to battle.

entities.name: Nefarox
entities.description: Grixis demon whose servants destroyed Kaalia's village and who killed her family.

entities.name: Nira
entities.description: Nacatl who saved Lia and named her Kaa.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event after which Kaalia was born.

events.summary: Servants of Nefarox destroy Lia's village; Nira saves her and, recognizing her abilities, enlists her to destroy the dragon skeleton's keystone.
events.quote: Lia was saved by the Nacatl Nira

events.summary: Kaalia destroys the dragon skeleton, but Nefarox rises and kills her family, the villagers and Nira.
events.quote: Nefarox rose and killed her family, all the villagers, and Nira

events.summary: Kaalia awakens empty with a fractured soul and grows consumed by a thirst for revenge.
events.quote: her soul was fractured, and a growing hatred soon grew in the cracks

relations.quote: she named the girl Kaa ("power") Lia
